comparator.name: Theology (Theologie)
comparator.academicYear: Adopted 2026–27 OER for the full-time standard 180-EC route, checked 2026-09-25; current public prospective year pages also consulted
comparator.route: Ordinary full-time 180-EC Theology bachelor, first-listed 15-EC thematic module and 30 EC free space
comparator.sourceNotes: The target is Radboud bachelor Theology CROHO 56109 with full-time and part-time delivery; this coherent 180-EC reconstruction uses the ordinary full-time academic sequence, not the 120-EC shortened route, part-time pacing or 180-EC Theology master. The 2026–27 adopted OER identifies 150 EC major (135 EC required major units plus one 15-EC required thematic module) and 30 EC genuinely free minor space. Its Appendix II identifies 60 EC required in year one, including 5 EC Liturgiewetenschap, biblical Hebrew, biblical interpretation, fundamental theology, pastoral theology, dogmatics and religious inquiry. The public year-one page displays only 55 positive EC while claiming 60 and omits Liturgiewetenschap; the applicable adopted OER supplies the missing compulsory unit. Year two has 60 EC required in theology, Christian history, ethics, Greek, New Testament exegesis, church law, spirituality and the 10-EC methods/research project. Year three comprises 5 EC humanities practice, one selected 15-EC required thematic module, 30 EC genuinely free minor space and a 10-EC independent theology final work. The first-listed module Worldviews, Nature and Climate is selected neutrally; its three 5-EC components are identified by the OER. Other module options and the optional teacher minor are not added. Public pages use descriptive names for some units, while the OER supplies their formal 2026–27 status and credits.

routeSelection.route: Ordinary full-time 180-EC Theology bachelor, first-listed 15-EC thematic module and 30 EC free space
routeSelection.basis: The target is the ordinary Theology bachelor, not the separate shortened programme or master. The adopted OER allows a choice of one required thematic module in year three; the first-listed Worldviews, Nature and Climate module is selected independently of UCR fit. The 30-EC genuinely free space remains unspecified; full-time pacing is used to display the coherent 60+60+60 academic route.

exception.reason: The programme’s defining 150-EC major is explicitly Christian theology and related methods: biblical Hebrew and Greek, Old and New Testament interpretation, doctrinal and fundamental theology, pastoral and liturgical practice, church history and law, theology-specific ethics and spirituality, a required religion-based module and an independent theology final work. Only 30 EC is genuinely free. UCR offers philosophy, history, ethics, sociology, literature and cultural analysis but no sustained biblical-language, scriptural exegesis, theology, liturgy or pastoral sequence. A 24-course schedule in neighbouring humanities/social-science fields would erase this bachelor’s Christian theological identity.
exception.curriculumContext: The official public year-one page has a material 5-EC omission, so Appendix II of the adopted 2026–27 OER supplies Liturgiewetenschap and resolves the year to 60 EC. The second-year OER and page total 60 EC; the third year consists of 5 compulsory practice, 15 one selected module, 30 genuinely free, and 10 compulsory thesis EC. The OER confirms a 150-EC major and 30-EC free minor space. It governs 2026–27 enrolment, while later offerings may change. Both full-time and part-time modes refer to the same degree, but part-time pacing is not conflated with an additional curriculum.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 current enriched UCR workbook course rows, including descriptions, profile/topic enrichment, prerequisites and planned terms. GOSPHIL111/212/214 and GOSPOLI111 support broad metaphysics, ethics and philosophy of mind; GOSSOCI111/214/311 and GOSPOLI112/311 support social institutions, faith-adjacent public life and politics; GOSHIST111/211 and MCCLITR112/211 offer broad historical and literary materials; MCCHEAM112/211 and GOSLAWJ111/213 touch heritage and legal rights. The workbook contains no dedicated Christian theology, liturgics, pastoral theology, systematic theology, biblical Hebrew or Greek, Old/New Testament exegesis or theological research sequence. Isolated philosophical, historical and literary encounters cannot underpin a defensible 24-course Theology alternative.
